provenance.construction: Open-boundary weight-8 Tile CSS code with B=4 on a 14 x 14 bulk, obtained by one support swap from the published B=4 tile. The X-tile support is {h00,h03,h22,h30,v01,v11,v20,v33}; boundary truncation gives n=578 and k=18. The submitted single-layer planar layout has one qubit per site, interaction radius sqrt(37) (approximately 6.0828), and maximum stabilizer weight 8.
provenance.notes: Pareto point in the weight-8 x local-2d-bilayer track: relative to [[512,18,19]], it retains k=18 and maximum check weight 8 while trading 66 additional qubits for a one-step larger witnessed distance bound. Explicit valid X- and Z-logical witnesses have weights 20 and 21, establishing d <= 20 only; no exact-distance claim is made.
